result.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
result.summary: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

AI.brief_summary: MovieRoll 提出面向长视频流式生成的 base-to-distilled 框架，包含窗口式 teacher forcing 基座训练、按层注意力模式分层压缩 KV-cache、以及长自 rollout 上平均局部梯度的蒸馏训练，并配合推理期 KV 重算与 guidance 退火以延长生成时长。
AI.relevance_reason: 其浅层保留全历史、深层保留 sink 与近期历史的缓存组织方式，以及长 rollout 中仅保留单个计算图并平均局部梯度的训练监督，可能为 latent 推理的状态缓存结构与长轨迹训练提供可供核查的线索，但任务属视频生成，迁移价值需进一步判断。
